title: Dark Fantasy Extraction sword & magic RPG
author: ElBatchos
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I'm currently working on a dark fantasy PvPvE extraction RPG, and I just finished building a section of the main town!

A big part of my development process has been preparing specific workflows for different parts of the game, like assets, magic and animations.

I also use Blender MCP with Python scripts to automate parts of the 3D workflow, using real photos, pictures and paintings as references.

For animations, I actually filmed myself doing the movements, then used the MetaHuman Animator Marker plugin in Unreal Engine to help turn them into animations. After that, I used AI to correct and improve the results with more specific instructions.

One thing I've learned is how important it is to have a proper project bible, with specific rules for each workflow and AI agent. Keeping it updated and checking that everything follows it takes time, but it's really important to get consistent results.

I'm still working on the game, and I'd be happy to share more of my progress here if you guys are interested!

I'd also love to hear how you organize your AI workflows for game development and what tips woud you give me ?
